traits.name: Smoke Vision
traits.text: Smoke doesn't impair an underworld dragon's vision; they ignore the concealed condition from smoke.

traits.name: Sweltering Heat
traits.text: (arcane, aura, evocation, fire); 10 feet. Each creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude saving throw or become fatigued while it remains in the aura.

traits.name: Adamantine Claws
traits.text: The dragon's claws are infused with adamantine. Their claw Strikes ignore half the Hardness of any object hit.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation, fire); The dragon breathes a blast of fire that explodes in a 25-foot burst within 50 feet, dealing 10d6 (10d6) fire damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save). Creatures that fail the save also take 2d6 (2d6) persistent fire damage. The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Coiling Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes one claw Strike and one tail Strike in either order, each against the same target. If either Strike hits, the dragon automatically Grabs the target.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +24 (magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+13 (2d8+13) piercing plus 2d6 (2d6) fire

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +24 (agile, magical); Damage 2d8+13 (2d8+13) slashing plus adamantine claws and Grab
